definitions.gloss: close examination; careful scrutiny; thorough inspection
definitions.explanation: Examining something in detail and with great care to verify accuracy or quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精査|せいさ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: I will examine the documents carefully before making a decision.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精査|せいさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time to carefully examine the data.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精査|せいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A thorough examination of the budget proposal is necessary.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{精|せい} (detailed, precise) + {査|さ} (examine, investigate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精査|せいさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ - to conduct a close examination
- {精査|せいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧ - thorough examination is needed
- {精査|せいさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ - as a result of close examination
- {精査|せいさ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ - under examination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧ - consideration, review (more general)
- ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ - investigation, survey (broader scope)
- ⟦{吟味|ぎんみ}→吟味：07505_ginmi⟧ - scrutiny, careful selection
- ⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧ - examination, screening (often for approval)

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business, academic, and government contexts.
